blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is withholding ₱14 million in retention funds from contractor Sunwest over an allegedly substandard ₱289 million flood control project in Oriental Mindoro. The project led to a malversation case against former Ako Bicol Representative Zaldy Co and nine others. DPWH Finance Division chief Cecilia Vicquerra, a witness presented by the counsel of project engineer Felisardo Casuno, appeared before the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division on Thursday. Vicquerra signed a certification dated Sept. 17, 2026 stating that the DPWH has yet to release the retention amount to Sunwest, which was co-founded by Co. The […]...
